notes.decision: Lone 'ⲣⲁ' on line 25 (and flanking line 27) appears to be either a decorative paragraph marker, a fragmentary word, or part of a structural framing device for the chapter heading on line 26. Translated as '(decorative marker)' pending parallels. Could conceivably be ⲡⲣⲁ 'the matter' or similar truncated word.

Translated 'stoops downward': ⲙⲟⲩⲍ likely Lyc. for ⲙⲟⲟⲩⲗ/ⲙⲟⲩⲗⲍ̄ 'sink, bow down' or related vertical-motion verb (with ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛ̄ 'downward'). Could alternatively be ⲙⲟⲩϩ 'fill (downward)' = stuff oneself, gluttonize. The chapter heading concerns why a man X downward — apparently a body-discipline question. Confidence moderate.

Translated 'addressed the apostle': ⲱⲛ = Lyc. ⲟⲩⲱⲛ 'open (mouth),' standard dialogue-introduction idiom (cf. accumulated vocabulary). The opener ⲱⲛ ⲡⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ = 'opened (mouth) to the apostle' = 'addressed the apostle.'

Translating as 'inquiry forth' — verb of inquiry/seeking opening the disciple's question. The Lyc form ⲛⲟⲩⲓⲉⲧ likely reflects ⲱⲛⲧ/ϣⲓⲛⲉ family. The phrase frames the entire kephalaion as response to a disciple's question.

Reading as qualitative 'still, motionless' (cf. ⲍⲣⲁⲕ 'be calm/still' in glossary) describing the reflected face below. Alternative reading 'downward' (= ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ) less likely since ⲥⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ already supplies the directional sense.

ⲙⲁⲣⲉ here as causative-jussive 'let his face be manifested forth to him' — describing the reflective phenomenon. The ϩⲏⲙⲁⲛⲉ ('signify,' Greek σημαίνει) on line 20 confirms this is the figurative-correspondential mode of the kephalaion.
ϯⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ = 'give a sign,' Lyc verbal idiom (= Sah. ϯⲙⲁⲉⲓⲛ). The reflected face turned downward IS the sign of the cosmic Call descending. Direct correspondential register.
'The Call' — standard Manichaean technical term per glossary. The reflected face plunging downward signifies the cosmic Call going down to the First Man in darkness.

Translating as 'multitude' / 'manifoldness' from ⲙⲛⲧ- abstract + ⲁϣⲁⲓ̈ 'be many.' Cf. accumulated ⲙⲛⲧⲁϣⲓⲣⲉ 'multitude/numerousness.' Alternative reading 'a great many' fits the cosmological-victorious context: the Call's victory over the lower cosmoi consists in its capacity to descend manifoldly.

Reading as 'lifts himself up' — paralleling line 15's 'casts himself down.' The verbal element ⲃⲓ probably from ϥⲓ 'lift, bear' with reflexive ϫⲱϩ = ⲭⲱϩ 'himself.' Captures the upward-motion antithesis to the downward-motion of line 15, generating the second mystery (Answer).
Greek σημαίνει 'signifies' — the explicit correspondential signaling verb. The reflected face IS the sign that signifies the cosmic mystery.

'The Answer' — standard Manichaean technical term per glossary. The face mirrored upward from below signifies the cosmic Answer/Hearing rising from the First Man back to the Living Projection. Forms the ⲧⲱϩⲙ/ⲥⲱⲧⲙ Call-Answer dyad.
'The Living Projection' (per glossary) — the upward-arrival point of the Answer. ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'living' restored from standard Manichaean usage.
Reading 'in this matter, hear' as the Apostle's standard pedagogical formula — the disciple is invited to attend so the teacher may instruct (ⲧⲁⲧⲥⲉⲃⲁⲕ 'that I may teach you' from ⲥⲃⲱ).

'Zodiac-signs' — plural variant of ⲛϩⲱⲁⲓⲟⲛ in glossary. The mystery now extends from human/animal/tree faces in water to the cosmic mystery of stars and zodiac signs reflected in the great sea — the macrocosmic correspondence.

Translated as 'the upper side' (variant of ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲧⲉ in glossary, the upper region) rather than 'the chosen one' (the Zarathustra epithet). The parallelism with ⲡⲥⲁⲙⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'the lower side' (line 7) and the spatial-correspondential context (Fathers above gazing down at lower realm) confirms this reading. The orthography ⲥⲁⲧⲧ for ⲥⲁⲛⲧⲧⲉ shows further contraction.
Translated as 'icon' (= Greek εἰκών). Lycopolitan ⲁⲕⲟⲛ for εἰκών with prosthetic ϩ- for the rough breathing. Same lexeme appears in line 13 paired with ⲍⲁⲓ̈ⲃⲉⲥ 'shadow' confirming 'image/icon' sense.

Line 16 contains physically-present text whose meaning resists confident parsing. ⲁⲣⲡⲉ may be a defective/dialectal form (possibly related to ⲁⲣⲡⲉⲓ 'reach/extend' or ⲣ̄ⲡⲉ 'be heavy'); ⲕⲙⲧ[ⲟ] likely completes ⲕⲙⲧⲟ 'earthquake/disturbance' (in glossary); ⲱⲃⲉ may be the end of a longer word in the lost portion. Kept untranslated in English as a placeholder rendering, with notes for human review.

Translated 'stretched downward.' ⲥⲣⲁⲕⲉ is likely related to ⲥⲱⲣ 'spread' or ⲥⲱⲣⲕ̄ 'pull, draw' — the shadow is stretched/extended down upon the earth even as the body that casts it hangs upward (line 21). The cosmological-correspondential point: the cosmic body has come up out of the Deep, and its 'shadow' extends downward in the lower world.
